title: Investment programs and measures
description: Investment programs and measures. Verify investment-program hierarchy and annual approval, assignments to WBS/internal orders, investment profiles, budget distribution and asset-under-construction settlement. IMTP/IMPR/IMZO are candidate configuration/reference structures, not a finished investment-measure posting schema. Preserve externally meaningful identifiers and map internal object numbers.
